title: Examining the Expanding Role of Synthetic Data Throughout the AI Development Pipeline

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative interviews evaluating how the use of auxiliary models for synthetic data generation defaults to normative assumptions, thereby reinforcing Western cultural hegemony and marginalizing alternative cultural perspectives.

Qualitative interviews documenting AI practitioners' observations of auxiliary models generating stereotypical responses (e.g., associating Mexican socio-cultural identity prompts exclusively with "tacos") or racist concepts during automated red-teaming.

Qualitative thematic analysis of practitioner and expert interviews discussing the challenges of generating synthetic data that accurately depicts underrepresented populations without relying on generic caricatures or skewed distributions.
